usedFor: Evenium manages event registrations, and Sangam CRM keeps the leads “Create or Update Lead” writes from “New Guests Added”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Guests become leads for follow-up after the event, and the update path avoids duplicating a returning guest.

watchOut: “New Guests Added” in Evenium is polling, so leads arrive after a scheduled check, not at registration.
